tx:
▸ Full process
To make the waxed sled, players must talk to Dunstan, who is to the south of Burthorpe training camp, outside the house with the anvil.
One must have the following in the backpack:
• Iron bar
• Maple or yew logs
• Rope
• Swamp tar
• Bucket of wax
• Cake tin
First, the player must speak to Dunstan to make the sled. Players must then use the swamp tar with the bucket of wax. Then the wax will be put into the cake tin. Players should then use the wax with the made sled, creating the waxed sled.
It is equipped when one needs to sled down Trollweiss Mountain during and after the quest Troll Romance to get from the peak to near the southern base where the rare Trollweiss flowers grow. Players can obtain a new sled by the same method or from the spawn point on Trollweiss Mountain.
If a player cannot currently obtain a sled, completing the updated Death Plateau quest will give Dunstan the option to make a new one.
